newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Inc analyst Steve Lewins said he cut its 1997 earnings estimate for AMR Corp to $8.50 a share from $10.00 a share to reflect the cost of labor talks, strike preparations, lost traffic and fare discounting.
-- said the averted strike by American's pilots could cost the airline $100-$200 million in the first quarter due to lost bookings, some cancelled flights and other strike preparations.
-- said the "non-strike" could hurt the rest of U.S. airline industry by $200-$400 million as carriers slash fares to match American's discounts.
